title: Rebuild admin module and persist admin access control across upgrades

requirements.text: Fix the backend so that admin/access-control state persists across canister upgrades, so admins added via the UI remain admins after redeploys.

quotes: Ik kan nog steeds geen admin's toevoegen, kun je heel het admin deel herbouwen?

acceptanceCriteria: After granting admin to a target Principal via `grantAdminRole`, that Principal is still recognized as admin after a canister upgrade/redeploy.

Admin-only guarded methods (e.g., `getAllAdmins`, `getGoogleSheetsDownloadLink`, `getUserProfile`, `getGrantedAdmins`, `grantAdminRole`) continue to enforce admin access correctly both before and after upgrade.
No admin/access-control data is lost on upgrade.

requirements.text: Implement the requested initial-admin rules in the backend: (1) the first-ever user who logs in with Internet Identity becomes an admin, and (2) the hardcoded Principal `nq44w-zh7mz-vkidk-kanua-rfijv-g2ail-o6b4k-ts6iu-qwwlh-e4le5-vqe` is always an admin.

quotes: in het begin zijn er 2 admins, de eerste admin is de eerste inlogger met internet identity en ook nog standaard de gebruiker: nq44w-zh7mz-vkidk-kanua-rfijv-g2ail-o6b4k-ts6iu-qwwlh-e4le5-vqe.

acceptanceCriteria: On a fresh deployment with no prior state, the first authenticated Internet Identity caller becomes an admin without manual intervention.
The Principal `nq44w-zh7mz-vkidk-kanua-rfijv-g2ail-o6b4k-ts6iu-qwwlh-e4le5-vqe` is always treated as admin (even if not present in any stored admin list).
The “first-ever login becomes admin” behavior is applied exactly once and does not change when later users log in.
The initial-admin behavior remains correct after canister upgrades (i.e., the already-established first admin remains admin).

requirements.text: Rebuild the admin feature end-to-end so that an admin can reliably grant admin rights to another user by entering their Principal ID from the existing Profile section, and the Admin list updates to reflect the change.

quotes: 1. een admin moet andere gebruikers via principal id admin kunnen maken.
2. in een profielsectie die er nu al reeds is

acceptanceCriteria: From the Profile page, when an admin enters a valid Principal ID and clicks Grant, the backend grants admin rights and returns success.
After a successful grant, the admin list shown on the Profile page includes the newly granted admin without requiring a full page reload.
Invalid Principal IDs are rejected by the UI with a clear error message and do not call the backend.
Non-admin users do not see the Admin Controls section.

requirements.text: Ensure the admin listing APIs are correct and stable: `getAllAdmins()` must return a de-duplicated list containing the hardcoded admin plus all granted admins, and it must remain accurate after upgrades.

quotes: ik kan nog steeds geen admin's toevoegen, kun je heel het admin deel herbouwen?

acceptanceCriteria: `getAllAdmins()` returns each admin principal at most once, even if the hardcoded admin is also present in the granted list.
Admins added via `grantAdminRole` appear in `getAllAdmins()` and `getGrantedAdmins()` consistently.
Admin list results remain consistent after canister upgrade/redeploy.

constraints: Keep all Motoko logic within the single actor in `backend/main.mo` (single-actor architecture).
Do not edit any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or any frontend paths marked immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text (UI labels, toasts, error messages).
Do not introduce external databases or third-party auth providers; Internet Identity remains the only auth method.
nonGoals: Adding role types beyond user/admin (e.g., moderator, editor).
Adding admin removal/demotion functionality unless required to make admin granting reliable.
Implementing real-time updates (e.g., WebSockets) for admin list changes.

miscToAdd: User wants the admin module rebuilt so admins can grant admin via Principal ID in the existing Profile section, with initial admins being (a) first-ever Internet Identity login and (b) fixed principal nq44w-zh7mz-vkidk-kanua-rfijv-g2ail-o6b4k-ts6iu-qwwlh-e4le5-vqe.
